ourStory.heading: Our Story
ourStory.subtitle: Get to know the people and the values behind Precise Carpet Cleaning Services.

cards.title: Who we are
cards.content: With 9 years of experience in professional carpet cleaning, we provide reliable, high-quality cleaning services for homes and businesses across Sydney. For the past 3 years, we have operated our own carpet cleaning business, bringing hands-on expertise and professional service to every job.

cards.title: Our equipment
cards.content: We use modern, professional-grade carpet cleaning equipment designed to deliver a deep and thorough clean. Whether it's everyday dirt, heavily used carpets or carpets that need refreshing, our aim is to achieve excellent results while treating every property with care.

cards.title: What we do
cards.content: Our services include residential and commercial carpet cleaning, end-of-lease carpet cleaning, and advanced stain removal treatments. We understand that different carpets and stains require different approaches, so we assess the condition of the carpet and use the appropriate cleaning method for the job.

cards.title: Where we work
cards.content: We proudly service Sydney and surrounding areas, helping homeowners, tenants, landlords and businesses keep their carpets clean and presentable. Our focus is simple: professional workmanship, dependable service and quality results you can see.

results.heading: Consistent Results At Every Visit
results.paragraph: We've got the right tools and products to give you a way deeper clean than your usual DIY stuff.
features: More free time for family or work

howItWorks.heading: How Netly Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Please select the service you want, choose a date, and let us know how long you need it for in minutes, if you could.

steps.title: 1. Book Your Service
steps.description: Choose your cleaning service, select a convenient date, and tell us what your space needs.

steps.title: 2. We Deep Clean
steps.description: Our professionals use specialized equipment and proven cleaning methods to tackle dirt and built-up grime.

steps.title: 3. Enjoy Fresh Carpets
steps.description: Sit back and enjoy a cleaner, fresher environment that looks and feels great.

team.heading: People You Can Trust
team.subtitle: Our dedicated team consists of highly trained professionals who take immense pride in their work and strive to deliver exceptional results.
